template.name: genetic_coder
template.description: A Fabric template designed for using the Genetic Coder.
template.objective: Build a robust and efficient code generation process that leverages genetic algorithms to optimize code quality, performance, and maintainability.

constraints.tool_context: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

fitness_function.name: code_quality_and_performance
fitness_function.description: Score candidates by tests, runtime, memory, simplicity, maintainability, and evidence completeness.

sop: Partition ask into AskSet, ConstraintSet, CodeSet, TestSet, EvidenceSet.
Ask Aider or the main model for first/last page outline only.
Generate candidate code blocks from weighted snippets and kernel citations.
Compile or parse each candidate before runtime testing.
Mutate only the failing block; do not rewrite the entire program unless fitness collapses.
Store passing candidates as vector citations and Fabric wisdom.
Stop on objective pass, inconclusive evidence, emergency stop, or timebox.
template.tool_context_rule: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

information_hierarchy.output: natural GUI reply plus evidence summary
